SELECT E.EMP_NM, E.PRFL_IMG_FILE_ID,
D.DEPT_CD AS DEPARTMENT_DEPT_CD, D.PRNT_DEPT_CD AS DEPARTMENT_PRNT_DEPT_CD, D.DEPT_NM AS DEPARTMENT_DEPT_NM, D.USE_YN AS DEPARTMENT_USE_YN, D.FRST_REG_DT AS DEPARTMENT_FRST_REG_DT, D.FRST_RGTR_ID AS DEPARTMENT_FRST_RGTR_ID, D.LAST_MDFCN_DT AS DEPARTMENT_LAST_MDFCN_DT, D.LAST_MDFR_ID AS DEPARTMENT_LAST_MDFR_ID,
JP.JOB_PSTN_CD AS JOB_POSITION_JOB_PSTN_CD, JP.JOB_PSTN_NM AS JOB_POSITION_JOB_PSTN_NM, JP.USE_YN AS JOB_POSITION_USE_YN, JP.FRST_RGTR_ID AS JOB_POSITION_FRST_RGTR_ID, JP.FRST_REG_DT AS JOB_POSITION_FRST_REG_DT, JP.LAST_MDFR_ID AS JOB_POSITION_LAST_MDFR_ID, JP.LAST_MDFCN_DT AS JOB_POSITION_LAST_MDFCN_DT,
JG.JOB_GRD_CD AS JOB_GRADE_JOB_GRD_CD, JG.JOB_GRD_NM AS JOB_GRADE_JOB_GRD_NM, JG.USE_YN AS JOB_GRADE_USE_YN, JG.FRST_RGTR_ID AS JOB_GRADE_FRST_RGTR_ID, JG.FRST_REG_DT AS JOB_GRADE_FRST_REG_DT, JG.LAST_MDFR_ID AS JOB_GRADE_LAST_MDFR_ID, JG.LAST_MDFCN_DT AS JOB_GRADE_LAST_MDFCN_DT
FROM TB_EMPLOYEE E
LEFT JOIN TB_DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_CD = E.DEPT_CD
LEFT JOIN TB_JOB_POSITION JP ON JP.JOB_PSTN_CD = E.JOB_PSTN_CD
LEFT JOIN TB_JOB_GRADE JG ON JG.JOB_GRD_CD = E.JOB_GRD_CD
WHERE E.EMP_ID = #{empId}

SELECT E.EMP_ID, E.EMP_NM, MA.EMAIL_ADDR, E.PRFL_IMG_FILE_ID, E.GENDER_CD, E.MBL_TELNO, E.ZIP, E.ADDR, E.EXEC_YN, E.EMP_STAMP_FILE_ID AS MBR_STAMP_FILE_ID, E.JOB_DUTY_CN, E.ENTCO_YMD,
D.DEPT_CD AS DEPARTMENT_DEPT_CD, D.PRNT_DEPT_CD AS DEPARTMENT_PRNT_DEPT_CD, D.DEPT_NM AS DEPARTMENT_DEPT_NM, D.USE_YN AS DEPARTMENT_USE_YN, D.FRST_REG_DT AS DEPARTMENT_FRST_REG_DT, D.FRST_RGTR_ID AS DEPARTMENT_FRST_RGTR_ID, D.LAST_MDFCN_DT AS DEPARTMENT_LAST_MDFCN_DT, D.LAST_MDFR_ID AS DEPARTMENT_LAST_MDFR_ID,
JP.JOB_PSTN_CD AS JOB_POSITION_JOB_PSTN_CD, JP.JOB_PSTN_NM AS JOB_POSITION_JOB_PSTN_NM, JP.USE_YN AS JOB_POSITION_USE_YN, JP.FRST_RGTR_ID AS JOB_POSITION_FRST_RGTR_ID, JP.FRST_REG_DT AS JOB_POSITION_FRST_REG_DT, JP.LAST_MDFR_ID AS JOB_POSITION_LAST_MDFR_ID, JP.LAST_MDFCN_DT AS JOB_POSITION_LAST_MDFCN_DT,
JG.JOB_GRD_CD AS JOB_GRADE_JOB_GRD_CD, JG.JOB_GRD_NM AS JOB_GRADE_JOB_GRD_NM, JG.USE_YN AS JOB_GRADE_USE_YN, JG.FRST_RGTR_ID AS JOB_GRADE_FRST_RGTR_ID, JG.FRST_REG_DT AS JOB_GRADE_FRST_REG_DT, JG.LAST_MDFR_ID AS JOB_GRADE_LAST_MDFR_ID, JG.LAST_MDFCN_DT AS JOB_GRADE_LAST_MDFCN_DT
FROM TB_EMPLOYEE E
LEFT JOIN TB_DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_CD = E.DEPT_CD
LEFT JOIN TB_JOB_POSITION JP ON JP.JOB_PSTN_CD = E.JOB_PSTN_CD
LEFT JOIN TB_JOB_GRADE JG ON JG.JOB_GRD_CD = E.JOB_GRD_CD
LEFT JOIN TB_MAIL_ACCOUNT MA ON MA.EMP_ID = E.EMP_ID
WHERE E.EMP_ID = #{empId}

SELECT RA.ROLE_ASSIGN_ID, RA.EMP_ID, RA.ROLE_ID, RA.ENABLED, RA.SCOPE_TYPE_CD, RA.SCOPE_ID,
R.ROLE_ID AS ROLE_ROLE_ID, R.ROLE_CD AS ROLE_ROLE_CD, R.ROLE_NM AS ROLE_ROLE_NM, R.ROLE_EXPLN AS ROLE_ROLE_EXPLN, R.FRST_RGTR_ID AS ROLE_FRST_RGTR_ID, R.FRST_REG_DT AS ROLE_FRST_REG_DT, R.LAST_MDFR_ID AS ROLE_LAST_MDFR_ID, R.LAST_MDFCN_DT AS ROLE_LAST_MDFCN_DT
FROM TB_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT RA
LEFT JOIN TB_ROLE R ON R.ROLE_ID = RA.ROLE_ID
WHERE RA.EMP_ID = #{empId}
